record.context_brief: Systematic construction of equienergetic non-cospectral trees.
record.original_question: Construct, by a systematic general method rather than by isolated examples or ad hoc searches, pairs of trees that have the same number of vertices and the same graph energy but are not cospectral. Here the energy of a graph means the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix, and two graphs of the same order are equienergetic when these energies are equal.

evidence.quote: (1) Although it is known that there are numerous pairs of equienergetic, non-cospectral trees, it is not known how to systematically construct any such pair.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple undirected graph with adjacency matrix A(G), and let λ_1, λ_2, …, λ_n denote the eigenvalues of A(G). The energy of G is defined by
   E(G) = Σ_{i=1}^{n} |λ_i|.
Two graphs of the same order are called equienergetic if their energies are equal, and they are cospectral if their adjacency matrices have the same multiset of eigenvalues.

Provide a systematic general construction (not depending on isolated examples, exhaustive computer search, or case-by-case ad hoc methods) that produces, for infinitely many values of n, pairs (T_1, T_2) of trees on n vertices such that:
  (i) T_1 and T_2 each have exactly n vertices;
  (ii) E(T_1) = E(T_2);
  (iii) T_1 and T_2 are not cospectral (i.e., their adjacency spectra differ).

The construction should be described as an explicit procedure or family of operations on trees, applicable in a uniform way, and it should be proved that the resulting trees satisfy (i)–(iii).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of systematically constructing pairs of equienergetic non-cospectral trees appears to remain open. While numerous examples are known and systematic constructions for equienergetic non-cospectral graphs (using iterated line graphs of regular graphs, products of complete graphs, etc.) exist, these constructions do not yield trees. Partial progress includes constructions of infinite families of equienergetic trees of diameter 4, but a general systematic construction method is still lacking.

status_evidence.title: Equienergetic and almost-equienergetic trees
status_evidence.snippet: It is not known how to systematically construct any pair of equienergetic, non-cospectral trees.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of systematic construction of equienergetic non-cospectral tree pairs is explicitly stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Constructing pairs of equienergetic and non-cospectral graphs
status_evidence.snippet: A systematic construction of pairs of non-cospectral connected graphs of the same order, having equal energies, using iterated line graphs of regular graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Systematic constructions exist for graphs in general but the methods rely on regular graphs and do not produce trees.
